Where To Learn More About Growing Great Indoor Strawberries

Posted by Growing Produce Staff|September 14, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:55
Instaread

Seeking to learn more about how to grow better strawberries under cover? The Strawberry School Online, presented by Ohio State University, offers all the keys to learn soilless production of strawberry under greenhouse and indoor controlled environment.

Contents include strawberry physiology, cultivar selection, production practices, and systems. Instructors for the course are Professor Chieri Kubota and lecturer Mark Kroggel. Students will have access to six lectures recorded previously. Additionally, students will be invited to live QA & discussion sessions scheduled during the course access period as needed (October 1 through Jan. 10, 2027). Students will need to review all lectures and complete knowledge checks to receive certificate of completion.

RELATED CONTENT: What’s Next for Berry Crops Grown Under Protective Cover?

This course is most suitable for those who are new in controlled environment agriculture and interested in strawberry production under controlled environment conditions such as greenhouses and vertical farms.

For more information about and to register for Strawberry School Online, CLICK HERE.
